name: Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd.
summary: Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd. leases land and buildings in Japan. The company leases office buildings, datacenter buildings, commercial buildings, logistics warehouses, and off-course betting parlors. It is also involved in buildings and machinery maintenance and cleaning services. The company was formerly known as Keihanshin Real Estate Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd. in October 2011. Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
